name: AgeVerif
author: Planet Season

sections.description:
AgeVerif is more than a simple “Are you over 18?” popup.

Protect your website with AgeVerif, the free age verification solution designed for websites that publish age-restricted content.

Comply with regulations and guidelines designed to prevent minors from accessing age-restricted content and verify the age of your visitors while respecting their privacy.

The official WordPress plugin lets you integrate AgeVerif in just a few minutes, without modifying your website’s code.

Why choose AgeVerif?
✔️ Multiple age verification and estimation methods developed in-house
✔️ Selected third parties methods providers
✔️ Reach over 25+ million already verified users
✔️ Compliant with various regulations around the world
✔️ Designed to protect visitors’ privacy
✔️ GDPR-compliant and certified system (AgeCheck, KJM, ICO)

Plugin highlights:
✅ Trigger modes: all pages, only matching URLs, or all except matching URLs
✅ Wildcard URL/path pattern matching (for example /categories/*)
✅ Optional admin bypass while logged in
✅ Checker script injected for immediate page-load behavior
✅ No coding skills required

Documentation:
Complete documentation available at https://docs.ageverif.com/plugins.html

External services

This plugin relies on the AgeVerif Checker Script service and provides a real age verification system with multiple verification methods, designed to help publishers comply with evolving age assurance regulations while offering visitors a smooth, privacy-friendly experience.

Service policies and terms:

  • Privacy Policy: https://www.ageverif.com/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Use: https://www.ageverif.com/terms-of-use
  • Webmaster Terms of Use: https://www.ageverif.com/webmaster-terms-of-use
  • Biometric Data Policy: https://www.ageverif.com/biometric-data-policy
  • Cookies Policy: https://www.ageverif.com/cookies-policy
  • COPPA Compliance: https://www.ageverif.com/coppa-compliance

AgeVerif is a service owned and operated by PlanetSeason (https://planetseason.com).
sections.installation:
1. Create an account at https://webmasters.ageverif.com [1]
  2. Get your Website Public Live Key.
  3. Download and install our plugin from the WordPress plugin repository.
  4. Activate AgeVerif in WordPress Admin.
  5. Read Getting Started page for first-time setup.
  6. Go to AgeVerif > Plugin Settings.
  7. Paste your Website Public Live Key.
  8. Configure Where To Trigger Verification and URL patterns if needed.
  9. Click Save Settings.

[1]: Free registration, no subscription, no hidden fees.

Complete documentation available at https://docs.ageverif.com/plugins.html
